blocks.text: Can a synthetic multi-center cohort test whether PostEx preserves observational-study design and uncertainty?
A fixed seed generated 2,400 synthetic records across 3 simulated centers: 960, 840 and 600 records.
Cohort construction -> pre-specified confounders -> inverse-probability weighting -> adjusted model -> negative-control and center sensitivity analyses.
The authored adjusted estimate was HR=1.18 with 95% CI 1.05-1.32.
All 3 simulated centers were directionally consistent; the negative-control estimate was HR=1.01.
LUMEN-24 is a traceability fixture for observational communication and supports no causal, clinical or biological inference.
